# KukiLab

> Hybrid security scanner for AI agent skills (Claude Code, Codex, MCP) that repairs skills until the verdict is SAFE.

- Repository: https://github.com/kukilab/scanner (MIT)
- GitHub Action: `uses: kukilab/scanner@v1`
- Agent skill: `npx skills add kukilab/scanner --skill kukilab-scan`
- Threat taxonomy P-01..P-10: https://github.com/kukilab/scanner/blob/main/docs/llm-threat-taxonomy-prompt-guide.md
- Related, independent project that checks skills and benchmarks scanners: https://skillverdict.dev
